places.quote: I passed the bridge of Pélissier, where the ravine, which the river forms, opened before me
places.note: Location approximate; the bridge's modern identity is uncertain.

places.quote: Soon after, I entered the valley of Chamounix.
places.note: Named as a valley here; the village is named again later.

places.quote: not so beautiful and picturesque as that of Servox, through which I had just passed
places.note: Shelley's spelling of the Servoz valley.

places.quote: Mont Blanc, the supreme and magnificent Mont Blanc, raised itself from the surrounding _aiguilles_
At length I arrived at the village of Chamounix.
places.note: Same place as the valley of Chamounix; listed separately as the village.

places.quote: listening to the rushing of the Arve, which pursued its noisy way beneath
